# Afrishore

> Afrishore — Local Solutions for Global Clients. Integrated marine logistics agency operating across South Africa, Namibia, and Mozambique since 2010. ISO 9001 certified. Direct contracts with TotalEnergies, Halliburton, Baker Hughes, Odfjell Drilling, Island Drilling, Tidewater, Solstad, Bourbon, and other major oil and gas operators, drilling contractors, and offshore vessel operators.

## What Afrishore does

Three integrated service pillars supporting offshore oil and gas, subsea engineering, and maritime infrastructure operations.

### Ship & Rig Agency

Full vessel management for rigs, drillships, OSVs, PSVs, tankers, and passenger liners across all South African and Namibian ports. Port clearance, customs and immigration, agency formalities, crew rotation, medivac coordination, bunkering arrangements.

### Offshore Supply Base Operations

Turnkey base operator services for offshore drilling campaigns: rigging, cranage, warehousing, project cargo handling, abnormal trucking, waste management, and customs. Permanently embedded inside the Port of Walvis Bay's Oil & Gas Section.

### Integrated Logistics Services

Freight forwarding, customs clearance, project cargo, materials management, bunkering, chandling, crew & visa services. Cross-border freight on sea and air for oil and gas, subsea, and heavy lift sectors.
